job_location: Quezon City, National Capital Region, Philippines
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain automated ETL/ELT processes to extract, transform, validate, and deliver data from multiple source systems.
Build and maintain integrations between business applications, APIs, databases, and enterprise reporting platforms.
Develop scalable and reusable data pipelines using Python, SQL, and appropriate integration technologies.
Extract data from REST APIs and other supported interfaces, handling authentication, pagination, rate limits, and errors as required.
Monitor data processing workflows and troubleshoot pipeline failures, integration issues, and data discrepancies.
Implement logging, error handling, validation, and reconciliation procedures to improve data reliability.
Maintain data quality, consistency, and traceability from source systems through final reporting outputs.
Develop and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic models, reports, dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting solutions.
Create and optimize DAX measures, calculated columns, Power Query transformations, relationships, and data models.
Translate business requirements into meaningful KPIs, reporting frameworks, and actionable insights.
Optimize report performance, model efficiency, data refresh processes, and user experience.
Manage Power BI Service workspaces, scheduled refreshes, gateway connectivity, and deployment practices as applicable.
Implement appropriate reporting standards, access controls, row-level security, and governance practices.
Support self-service analytics while maintaining consistent business definitions, metrics, and reporting standards.
Investigate and resolve reporting errors, refresh failures, performance issues, and discrepancies between source data and reported results.
Design, develop, and maintain MySQL database structures supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational data processing.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries, joins, views, stored procedures, and other database logic as appropriate.
Develop efficient data models, indexes, and database structures to support reliable and scalable reporting.
Monitor query performance and troubleshoot database bottlenecks, slow queries, and data integrity issues.
Maintain data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting databases and integrated systems.
Support database changes, data migrations, schema enhancements, and reporting platform improvements.
Document database structures, data relationships, dependencies, and business rules.
Coordinate with IT on database hosting, connectivity, backup and recovery, access controls, and infrastructure administration as applicable.
Develop Python scripts and reusable utilities for data extraction, transformation, validation, reporting, and operational automation.
Automate repetitive manual processes and reduce reliance on spreadsheet-based or manual reporting workflows.
Build and maintain API integrations and automated data processing routines.
Implement appropriate logging, exception handling, retry mechanisms, and error notifications.
Support scheduled and event-driven automation processes where applicable.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reduce processing time, and eliminate redundant activities.
Maintain readable, reusable, and well-documented code that can be supported and enhanced over time.
Work directly with department leaders and business users to understand reporting needs, operational challenges, and business objectives.
Gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications, data models, dashboards, and automated workflows.
Define and document KPIs, calculation methods, reporting rules, and measurement frameworks.
Analyze operational and business data to identify trends, performance gaps, opportunities, and potential improvements.
Validate results with stakeholders to ensure reporting outputs accurately reflect business processes.
Recommend data-driven improvements to workflows, reporting practices, and business operations.
Support management reporting, strategic planning, and decision-making through timely and reliable analytics.
Manage competing priorities and communicate project status, technical issues, risks, and delivery timelines.
Support data integration, reporting, and automation workloads operating within client's Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment.
Understand connectivity between source systems, MySQL databases, Power BI, and cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
Support Power BI Service configuration, gateway connectivity, refresh monitoring, and workspace administration as required.
Develop or maintain business workflows using Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel Power Query, and related Microsoft 365 tools.
Support scheduled jobs, platform monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability.
Work with IT and security teams on identity and access management, permissions, secure connectivity, and compliance requirements.
Follow established practices for credential protection, version control, testing, deployment, and change management.
Document system architecture, data flows, configurations, dependencies, and operational procedures.
Administer and support Linux-based application servers hosting reporting, analytics, integration, and automation workloads.
Monitor platform health, troubleshoot production issues, review logs, and ensure operational reliability of reporting and analytics solutions.
Support application deployments, scheduled jobs, configuration changes, and environment maintenance activities across development, QA, and production environments.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement logging, error handling, validation, and reconciliation procedures to improve data reliability.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities stress validation, reconciliation, data integrity and change management, with no speed or shipping language, so the posting reads as rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Support management reporting, strategic planning, and decision-making through timely and reliable analytics.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would mislead internal business and executive reporting across support functions; finance is one of several served functions and there is no financial-reporting or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Finance; Human Resources; Talent Acquisition; Marketing; Operations; Learning & Development; Shared Services; IT; security teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: Support database changes, data migrations, schema enhancements, and reporting platform improvements.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A MySQL reporting database, Power BI Service workspaces and gateways already exist and the role extends them, but it reads as a single end-to-end owner rather than a specialised team, so mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Extract data from REST APIs and other supported interfaces, handling authentication, pagination, rate limits, and errors as required.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Several bullets name exact tools and tasks (MySQL, Power BI gateways, REST API pagination) but many are generic, such as "Manage competing priorities and communicate project status", so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: The Data & BI Engineer will support multiple business functions, including Finance, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Marketing, Operations, Learning & Development, and Shared Services.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience spreads evenly across finance, HR, marketing, operations and shared services with no single function dominating, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: This role is responsible for owning the end-to-end data lifecycle
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns the data platform end to end ("owning the end-to-end data lifecycle") while delivering reports in service of department leaders, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The posting does not mention AI at all.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement logging, error handling, validation, and reconciliation procedures to improve data reliability.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Validation and reconciliation are framed as work the candidate implements and owns, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Maintain data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting databases and integrated systems.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The fear is pipeline failures and wrong numbers in reports, framed as operational reliability alongside delivery, not compliance, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: manage, develop, and enhance the organization's enterprise data, reporting, analytics, and automation capabilities
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The verbs are maintain, optimise, enhance and reduce manual work on an existing MySQL and Power BI estate, so fix_scale.
evidence.language_gate: Excellent written and spoken English communication.
evidence.loss_aversion: Validate results with stakeholders to ensure reporting outputs accurately reflect business processes.
